messages.author: e0691e26c9cf72eb
messages.subject: [R-sig-Debian] /etc/R/Renviron doesn't set R_LIBS_USER anymore
parts:
Public Service Announcement for Debian/Ubuntu R users.
If you've been installing packages to a local library in your user's
home things might stop working on the upgrade to 3.4.1

See the email thread:
[R-sig-Debian] /etc/R/Renviron doesn't set R_LIBS_USER anymore
https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-sig-debian/2017-July/002734.html

If you need help understanding what changed and how to fix/work-around
let me know.

Thanks,
--
Alex Mandel, PhD

Center for Spatial Sciences
http://spatial.ucdavis.edu
Geospatial and Farming Systems Research Consortium
http://gfc.ucdavis.edu
University of California, Davis
